oc_closedNote: The restaurant is currently closed — your order is queued and you'll get an update as soon as they open.
oc_cancelNote: If something unexpected comes up, you can still cancel your order here.
os_cancelledByCustomerBody: You cancelled your order — the restaurant has been told not to prepare it. If you change your mind, you can always place a new order.
co_cancelErrorSignIn: Sign in to cancel this order, or call the restaurant.
co_cancelErrorInvalidLink: This cancellation link isn't valid. Please use the link from your confirmation email, or call the restaurant.
co_cancelErrorAccepted: The restaurant has already accepted your order. Please call them directly to cancel.
co_cancelErrorGone: This order can no longer be cancelled.
rc_introCancelled: You cancelled your reservation at {restaurantName} — the restaurant has been notified and your table has been released.
rc_closingCancelled: If you change your mind, you're always welcome to book again.
rc_depositContactNote: You paid a deposit for this booking — please contact the restaurant directly about your deposit.
rc_cancelNote: If your plans change, you can cancel your reservation here.
resc_intro: You're about to cancel your reservation at {restaurantName}. The restaurant will be notified right away.
resc_successBody: Your reservation at {restaurantName} has been cancelled and the restaurant has been notified. We hope to see you another time!
resc_alreadyCancelledBody: This reservation has already been cancelled or updated by the restaurant — no further action is needed.
resc_invalidLinkBody: This cancellation link is invalid or no longer works. If you need to change a booking, please contact the restaurant directly.
resc_tooLateBody: This reservation can no longer be cancelled online — please contact {restaurantName} directly.
resc_linkedOrderBody: This booking is part of an order. To cancel it, use the cancellation link in your order confirmation email, or contact the restaurant.
resc_depositNote: You paid a deposit for this booking. Cancelling here does not automatically refund it — please contact the restaurant about your deposit.
resc_genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
